result.title: Do Knowledge and Reasoning Oriented Benchmarks Induce Stable Representation Signatures in LLMs?
result.comment: NeurIPS 2026 Interpretability as a Science Workshop
result.summary: Internal signatures could support monitoring, adaptive computation, and mechanistic analysis, but benchmark prompts can be separable without any shared computational distinction. We test whether a prespecified knowledge/reasoning label defines a reusable internal signature in five contemporary 7B to 31B models. We treat the \textbf{task} as the unit of inference probes hold out complete tasks, labels are permuted across tasks, and the best layer and stream are reselected for every permutation. Raw probes recover an eight-versus-eight-subject MMLU partition in all five models (macro-F1 $0.78$--$0.81$), but prompt text predicts it nearly as well: under an identical probe configuration, the activation advantage is only $0.017$--$0.070$ macro-F1 and is not significant. At the prespecified $0.01$ level, lexical adjustment removes significance while the adjusted states still identify individual subjects, and the selected site changes across task panels and selection rules. Additionally, two released base-training trajectories show no common direction. These pooled layerwise measures recover the task label but identify no transferable knowledge/reasoning signature at the tested sensitivity, which cannot exclude moderate effects. The resulting protocol gives future internal monitors and intervention studies a sequence of tests to pass. Project page: \url{https://parsa-ra.github.io/lmbehave/}.

AI.brief_summary: 论文检验知识／推理类基准是否在 7B–31B 语言模型内部形成可复用的表示特征：采用任务级留出、标签跨任务置换并逐次重选最佳层与表示流的探针协议，发现原始探针虽能区分 MMLU 任务，但提示文本几乎同等可预测，词法校正后激活优势不再显著，所选位点也随任务面板漂移。
AI.relevance_reason: 其探针与置换协议直接针对「内部状态是否携带任务必要信息、还是仅反映表面词法线索」这一问题，可为 LVR 中 latent 内容探针的混淆控制、层与位点选择以及负结果解释提供可供核查的方法线索，但需人工确认能否迁移到多模态视觉状态。
